from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial figure extracted from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company this filing belongs to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The name of the line item as it appears in the document (e.g., 'Accounts Receivable')")
    amount_value: str | None = Field(description="The numeric portion of the amount as written in the text")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', '$')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the figure for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_lines: list[FinancialLineItem]
